Plain flat solid magenta (#FF00FF) background, no ground scenery beyond the base plate, no shadows on the background. No flag, no banner, no people, no animals, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no signs, no watermark. Square 1:1 image.

The brass balance scale is a plain emblem of justice, not a religious symbol or logo. A grey gabled hall with a green copper roof keeps it apart from the red-roofed Forum colonnade and the Guildhall. The source image reached the project through a chat paste (a re-encode, not the owner's original file), so the recorded hash is of that pasted copy. Checked at full size: no lettering.
